title: HB0995 (110th General Assembly): As enacted, clarifies, for purposes of whether possession of a weapon is allowed or prohibited, when certain property is considered to be "in use" for school purposes. - Amends TCA Title 39, Chapter 17, Part 13.

operative_text:
SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1311(b)(1)(H)(iii)): For purposes of subdivision (b)(1)(H)(ii)(a) and (c), property described in subdivision (bxlXHX|) is "in use" onlywhen one (1) or more students are physically present on the property for an activity a reasonable person knows or should know is an athletic event, or other school event or school-related activity.
SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1311(b)(1)(H)(iii)): Property listed in subdivision (bxlXHXi) is not in use solely because equipment, materials, supplies, or other property owned or used by a school is stored, maintained, or permitted to remain on the property.
